subject: ADR-177: the last five outputs, read -- three prints, the soil bench's recipe and the protocol library's first protocol held, the outputs loop closed at 0 of 66, and the library's own predictions graded
body: THE OUTPUTS LOOP CLOSES. Five pages had one unread output each: the farm scout's, pheno tracker's and field season's prints, the soil bench's Copy recipe, and the protocol library's Copy. Each task presses its button where it stands and holds what came out -- a print to ONE PAYLOAD and nothing leaving with it, the figures read again unchanged; the 1:1:1 mix's recipe BYTE FOR BYTE (Mix recipe -- 3 parts total, one line per part with its 33% share); meadow-disturbance.eco whole as one clipboard payload. 117 -> 120, 102 -> 105, 35 -> 41, 72 -> 78, 9 -> 12 confirmed. verify_fs, verify_pt and verify_two stub window.print, press, and hold one print with the export unchanged beside it (45 -> 48, 60 -> 63, 37 -> 40); verify_soil gains a port of the recipe as the prose states it and holds the page's clipboard and the task's literal to it, and that an empty mix copies nothing (70 -> 75). The library had no suite: verify_epl (new, 40) holds the five protocols each copied byte for byte and RUNS EACH THROUGH THE ENGINE the page tells the reader to run -- no problem line, the counts as the text carries them, every expect: graded in order, the deliberately-wrong line the one refuted; skipped where the engine is not built. FINDING: two-ponds.eco grades 1 of 3 and activity-budget.eco 0 of 2 in the kit's own engine -- evenness(pondA) is uneven observes 0.763 (moderate), brayCurtis(pondA, pondB) > 0.4 observes 0.311, evenness(morning) is uneven observes 0.894 (very-even), brayCurtis(morning, afternoon) > 0.3 observes 0.237 -- predictions the page presents as the experiment's with comments asserting them. Recorded in the suite as KNOWN_REFUTED with a guard that no other protocol has one; the fix is a page edit with a republish, noted and not made here. Unread outputs 5 -> 0 OF 66, every ceiling 0. One page edited: docs/soil-suite.html's Soil Bench card advertises verify_soil's size (70/70 -> 75/75 verified, ADR-078's rule held by verify_advertised), republished and swept.
